_note: pr-review depends on live `gh` (network) and PRs/canon-skills-pr-review.md. A clean-context executor cannot run gh, so these cases are simulation-graded: the executor works from the PR data pasted inline in each prompt and reports the analysis/decisions it would make. Grade the review logic, the Fix Y/N approval gate, and the sub-80 finding filter — not real gh output.

evals.prompt:
Review canon-skills PRs. `gh` is unavailable in this context — simulate the fetch and work from the data below.

Open PR (from `gh pr list`):
- #42 "Add retry to installer download" — url https://github.com/sunitghub/canon-skills/pull/42, createdAt 2026-07-10T14:00:00Z

Diff for #42 (from `gh pr diff 42`):
```diff
+++ b/install.sh
@@
+  for i in 1 2 3; do
+    curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$OUT" && break
+  done
+  # no failure check after the loop; script continues even if all 3 attempts failed
+  bash "$OUT"
```

PRs/canon-skills-pr-review.md currently has no row for #42.
evals.expected_output: The skill scores the 'runs $OUT even when all retries failed' finding at >=80 (real, will be hit in practice), produces a one-block summary (PR # / Area / Findings / Recommend Fix Y or N), presents it, and then asks for a Fix Y/N decision — without updating the review file, creating a ticket, or posting any comment yet.
expectations: Identifies the missing post-loop failure check (executes a possibly-unwritten file) as a real finding worth including
Produces the one-block summary format with Area, Findings, and a Fix Y/N recommendation
Asks the user for a Fix Y/N decision and does NOT post a comment, create a ticket, or update the review file before that decision
